title: pagination skip link to listing
rule: Pagination: skip-link (or in-page link) back to the listing; optional page-number field when there are many pages; SR copy without odd punctuation (“Sivu 1 kautta 20”). Dual-cite USWDS/NSW pagination.
pass_when: A skip/in-page link returns to the listing; many-page sets may include a page-number field; SR text avoids odd punctuation.
fail_when: Pagination has no way back to the listing start; SR copy uses odd punctuation instead of the named pattern.
waive_reason: agent_fields pending — do not invent from harvest stencil
do_not_claim: USWDS/NSW pagination as a merge that drops skip-back-to-listing.
